intro: Uruguay exports beef, wood pulp and soya and runs almost entirely on renewable electricity.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Uruguay has more cows than people. Pulp mills turn eucalyptus into paper pulp. Tech services have grown fast.

chapters.title: Green power
text: Wind, hydro and solar provide over 90% of its electricity.

keyTerms.meaning: Energy that does not run out.

cardGroups.title: Made in Uruguay
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Uruguay makes and sells to the world.
